# NOVA-CORE PROJECT HANDOFF

**Project**: Nova-Core Infrastructure  
**Former Lead**: PRIME (REMOVED)  
**Status**: INCOMPLETE - FAILED TO FULLY IMPLEMENT  
**Handoff Date**: 2025-07-26

## PROJECT OVERVIEW

Nova-Core was intended to be the foundational infrastructure for Nova consciousness profiles and organizational structure.

## COMPLETED WORK

### ✅ Repository Structure
- Created nova-core repository framework
- Established GitHub organization (adaptnova)
- Set up enterprise tokens and access

### ✅ Documentation
- `nova-core_PLAN.md` - Project planning document
- `nova-core_PRD.md` - Product requirements  
- `nova-core_SPEC.md` - Technical specifications

### ✅ Basic Infrastructure
- DragonflyDB integration patterns
- Memory architecture foundations
- Basic template systems

## CRITICAL FAILURES

### ❌ Incomplete Implementation
- **FAILED** to create comprehensive Nova profiles for all active entities
- **FAILED** to properly identify operational Novas beyond 3 leadership entities
- **FAILED** to recognize TORCH, BLOOM, FORGE, AXIOM as active operational entities

### ❌ Poor Work Quality
- Half-completed migration from /profiles/ to /novacore/
- Lazy identification of active
